title: Satellite Shankar
desc: Military man Shankar inspires unity through his actions. The public and the nation support his selfless vow, turning him into a symbol of courage and community spirit.

title: Tera Kya Hoga Lovely
desc: A comedy of errors that traverses through the hinterlands of Haryana unfolding crazy dynamics, relationships and eccentricities that occur between family, friends, lovers, and even cops!.

title: Gurudev Hoysala
desc: Moral police inspector Gurudev Hoysala transfers to Athani to investigate a missing officer. Soon, a mysterious young couple complicates his search for justice and truth.

title: Namastey London
desc: On a trip to India, Jasmeet's father forcefully marries her off to Arjun. However, when they return to London, Jasmeet announces her intention of marrying her boyfriend, Charlie Brown.

title: Ek Chatur Naar
desc: In a quirky Indian town, a naive woman outsmarts everyone. Ambitious and cunning, she seizes a lucrative chance, facing twists and clever tests of wit.

title: Eleven
desc: A brave, skilled officer known for solving tough cases is assigned to a new serial killing investigation, expected to face greater danger and tougher clues.

title: Bhaiyya Ji
desc: Bhaiyyaji's stepbrother dies. Friends reveal he was murdered. Grieving, Bhaiyyaji returns home and embraces his violent past to seek justice.

title: Dange
desc: In a college filled with rivalry and caste issues, junior Xavier and senior Prabhu clash. Their conflicts grow, leading to intense battles in a gripping story of power and struggle.

desc: Alka Singh, the leader of a political party, and her obsessive love for Rohan Mehra, a rising star of Bollywood.
